source.filename: S-CSGD312 Game Design Principles and Practice Lecture.pdf

course_description: This course gives an overview of the game development process from ideas to creation. It discourses the history of game development process, exposure to the position and job responsibilities that each member of a game development team has along with the industry requirements ideas in Game Design Document (GDD).

course_learning_outcomes.text: demonstrate knowledge in concepts of game and game development;
demonstrate skills in creating assets using Game Engine and tools;
develop a simple game with proper game design documentation that follows the game standard
apply the game to a real-world problem; and
formulate the optimize design learned and present the expected output that can be achieved by developing game.
Understand the structure of mobile game programming.
Remember the basic framework for mobile game development.
Understand how physics affects in development of the game.
Apply the design learned and report the expected effectiveness of the mobile game.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Explain basic mobile game in a nutshell.
Apply key concepts of game processes, principles and ethics.
Detemine and generate mobile game programming.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Design the needs of game programming in the industry.
Develop an appreciation in virtual simulation technology.
Value the Lasallian values and sensitivity in developing a game to real-world problems.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Exhibit and demonstrate mobile game programming.
Develop games in Android mobile platform.
Collaboration, individual assessment to design and develop group project.
Collaboration and presentation of group project.
